running_thesis: Rates and a hiking Fed (Polymarket: 25 bps December hike 86.5%) are the main macro backdrop. The 10-year is at 5.15% and the real yield is rising. Nasdaq-100 is the higher-beta index (VXN minus VIX 10.08) and fell 1.22% on 13 Nov versus 0.40% for the S&P. NVDA CEO Huang resigned (8-K), a large single-stock overlay before NVDA earnings. Credit (HY OAS 3.2) shows no stress. Oil fell sharply from late October (stale data).
open_questions: Does the NVDA CEO change alter the earnings reaction?
Will retail sales and FOMC minutes harden the December hike path?
Is the 5 Nov Nasdaq-100 drop of 6.36% fully digested?
